Job Summary Reporting to the SVP, Finance, the Director, Procurement serves as AMN Healthcare’s senior procurement subject matter expert and strategic business partner, responsible for developing and executing enterprise sourcing, supplier management, procurement governance, and cost optimization strategies. This individual will develop and execute procurement strategies that optimize third-party corporate spend, deliver measurable financial value, improve supplier performance, mitigate risk, and support AMN Healthcare’s strategic and operational objectives. The Director will partner closely with senior business and functional leaders to drive sourcing strategies, supplier consolidation, demand management, contract negotiations, and procurement excellence across the enterprise. The Director will also drive the continued modernization of procurement capabilities through process improvement, analytics, automation, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions that strengthen sourcing effectiveness, spend visibility, supplier management, contract lifecycle management, decision-making, and operational efficiency. Work Location This position follows a hybrid work arrangement and is based in either Dallas, Texas or San Diego, California. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute an enterprise procurement strategy aligned with AMN Healthcare’s financial, strategic, and operational objectives. Build and manage an enterprise sourcing pipeline and cost optimization roadmap focused on realized savings, cost avoidance, supplier consolidation, demand management, and commercial value creation. Develop and execute category management strategies across major areas of third-party spend. Manage complex strategic sourcing initiatives, including supplier evaluations, competitive sourcing events, negotiations, supplier selection, and contract execution. Partner with Finance to establish methodologies for tracking, validating, and reporting procurement savings and value realization. Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships that improve service quality, performance, innovation, and business outcomes. Identify and mitigate supplier-related operational, financial, cybersecurity, contractual, regulatory, and business continuity risks. Drive procurement technology, automation, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives to improve procurement effectiveness and stakeholder experience. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve cycle times, and enhance stakeholder and supplier experiences. Oversee procure-to-pay processes, purchase order management, and catalog management activities. Develop dashboards and performance metrics measuring savings, spend under management, sourcing pipeline health, supplier consolidation, contract compliance, supplier performance, and sourcing cycle times. Support the integration and consolidation of supplier relationships, contracts, and procurement processes associated with acquisitions. Champion enterprise procurement best practices and promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement. Experience managing complex sourcing initiatives and negotiating significant commercial agreements with strategic suppliers. Demonstrated experience identifying, negotiating, tracking, and delivering cost savings, cost avoidance, supplier consolidation, and other value-creation initiatives. Strong financial and business acumen, including business case development, commercial analysis, vendor evaluation, and partnership with Finance. Demonstrate the ability to effectively use technology, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, support decision-making, and enhance business outcomes while adhering to company policies and responsible AI practices. Experience leveraging AI, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies to improve procurement performance and decision-making. Cross-border sourcing experience. Experience managing strategic supplier performance programs and enterprise-wide cost optimization initiatives. Knowledge of modern procurement technologies, spend analytics, automation solutions, supplier management tools, and contract lifecycle management capabilities. Experience supporting supplier and contract integration activities associated with acquisitions. Experience serving as the primary procurement advisor to senior executives and functional leaders across an enterprise organization. jobs.description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: The Manager, Marketing Measurement & Optimization will drive the measurement and investment agenda for PayPal Consumer Marketing, helping leaders understand what's working, where incremental opportunity exists, and how investment should evolve across markets, channels, products, and objectives. This role supports the Consumer model-to-decision cycle, partnering with Data Science, Finance, Media, Experimentation, and Marketing leaders to translate priorities into measurement questions, pressure-test outputs, and turn evidence into scenarios, trade-offs, and investment recommendations. The ideal candidate combines strong measurement expertise with commercial judgment. Rather than building every model or routine reporting, they'll ensure the right measurement approaches fit the right questions, assess whether results are fit for use, synthesize evidence across sources, and help Consumer Marketing leadership make better investment decisions. Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Lead the development and execution of marketing strategies and campaigns Identify and recommend best practices for marketing processes and initiatives Analyze business trends to inform marketing decisions and strategies Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive marketing projects and programs Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of marketing activities Provide guidance and mentorship to junior marketing team members Minimum Qualifications: 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Additional Responsibilities: Support the PayPal Consumer Marketing measurement and investment agenda, helping translate business priorities and leadership questions into a clear roadmap of measurement needs, analytical priorities, and investment decisions to be supported. Support the end-to-end application of Marketing measurement approaches, helping ensure methodologies are appropriately scoped to the business question, informed by business context, and applied to the decisions they were intended to support. Support the business application of marketing mix modeling and related measurement capabilities, partnering with Data Science on model requirements, inputs, assumptions, validation, interpretation, and approved use cases. Partner with Data Science to review and validate measurement outputs, helping ensure results are technically credible, commercially plausible, and fit for use before informing Marketing decisions. Support the framing of Marketing investment scenarios and optimization questions, helping define business assumptions, constraints, required scenarios, decision criteria, and recommendations for Marketing leadership. Help integrate multiple sources of evidence, including MMM, incrementality testing, attribution, forecasts, performance analytics, and business context, while helping stakeholders understand differences in methodology, scope, limitations, and interpretation. Help connect Marketing plans, measurement expectations, forecasts, and actual performance, identifying where outcomes diverge from prior assumptions and incorporating those learnings into future scenarios and investment recommendations. Contribute to executive-ready measurement and investment narratives, translating complex analytical findings into concise implications, recommendations, risks, and actions for PayPal Consumer Marketing stakeholders. Partner with the Global Measurement teams on enterprise allocation questions, providing PayPal Consumer scenarios, evidence, constraints, and recommendations to help evaluate opportunities across the broader Marketing portfolio. Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR any equivalent combination of education and experience. Working knowledge of marketing mix modeling, including model design considerations, input selection, calibration, validation, response curves, diminishing returns, marginal ROI, scenario planning, and common methodological limitations. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4. ABOUT THE COMPANY Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world. In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills. Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer. Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it. Our company values guide our daily actions: Safe : We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities. Committed to Serve : We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations. Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment. Driven : We deliver results in the right way. Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person. We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods. STRATEGY Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets. We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation. With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers. Recycling and Waste We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs. Environmental Solutions Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need. Sustainability Innovation Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth. The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America. Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).
